newsitem.title: CHILE: 35 hurt as tower collapses at Chile concert.
newsitem.headline: 35 hurt as tower collapses at Chile concert.

text.p: Some 35 people were hurt on Thursday when a tower holding loudspeakers collapsed at the start of a rock music concert in Chile, officials said.
Police said 20 people were trapped for a time under the debris, but all were rescued and the concert by Deep Purple was resumed.

The tower collapsed under the weight of a crowd that had climbed to see the band, which had only played three songs when the accident occurred. The tower fell on top of people sitting at Santa Laura Stadium in the northern part of Santiago.
There were no fatalities, but officials said some of the injuries were considered serious, with several victims suffering broken bones and concussions.
Officials said concert organisers decided to resume the performance in order to avoid further disturbances if the show was cancelled.
